title: Installments Paid Ahead with a One-Time TRICARE Prime Payment
content:
The method on file of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment counts as lapsed when the account shows no payment collected through it since a starting month. A one-time payment toward the enrollment pays installments ahead as follows:

| Method on file | Counts as lapsed | Installments paid ahead |
|---|---|---|
| recurring card or electronic funds transfer | yes | 1 regular installment |
| allotment | yes | 2 regular installments |
| any method | no | none |
| single card payment or check | - | none |

The installments paid ahead are added to what the settled installment calls for.

**Hypothetical.** An allotment that has collected nothing since its starting month, with installments paid ahead valued at 32.51 each: the one-time payment carries 65.02 for the installments paid ahead.
